verdict.rationale: Linear documents OAuth2 apps as the recommended way to integrate, and agents authenticate as their own app actors. Agent-specific OAuth scopes are documented (app:assignable, app:mentionable), and admins can approve third-party apps before installation, so a scoped, non-human credential model for agents exists. The evidence does not show fine-grained least-privilege controls such as read-only or write scopes, or restricting a credential to particular teams. Personal API keys are mentioned with no scoping at all. Missing for 10: documented granular read/write and resource-level scopes, scoping or restriction options for API keys, team or project-limited agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
